description: Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API) lets developers manage listings, orders, and fulfillment for Amazon sellers/vendors.
access_notes: Requires registering as an SP-API developer and registering an application through Seller Central; a private app works against the developer's own seller account fairly directly, but a public app (for other sellers to authorize) must go through Amazon's app approval/publishing process, and certain data categories require an additional Restricted Data Token grant. This is a multi-step, Amazon-gated flow rather than an open self-serve API key.
api_notes: Orders, listings, inventory, fulfillment, reports -- a large surface reflecting the full seller/vendor workflow.
main_blocker: Public-app distribution and restricted-data access both require Amazon approval steps beyond basic developer registration.
